description_en: Lists the types of multicloud data sources that Threat Analysis supports
description_zh: 枚举目前威胁分析支持的多云接入数据源类型
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem list-data-source-types --cloud-code hcloud --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDataSourceTypes

parameters.help_en: The code of the multicloud service
parameters.name: cloud_code

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Data Management center of Threat Analysis is located. Select the region of the management center based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in a region outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id
